pattern_title: Summary vs. Deep-Dive Timeline & Funding Drift
summary: Executive summary slide listed 18-month migration at $3.2M GSF while deep-dive staffing chevrons summed to 24 months and $4.6M GSF because legacy raw sheet tab was used instead of Post_Discount_InScope_Summary.
resolution: Reconciled every workstream chevron against the authoritative post-discount tab and updated Slide 2 rollup totals before pricing review.

pattern_title: Internal Rate Card & Credit Ratio Leak in Partner Deck
summary: Partner-facing scope proposal exposed internal GSF monthly FTE rate cards ($150K/mo) and exact GSF-to-PSF funding ratio, enabling external reverse-engineering of cloud consulting margins.
resolution: Removed internal rate card figures, credit pool percentages, and FTE-to-dollar breakdowns from partner deck; replaced with deliverable-based workstream outcomes and joint RACI milestones.

pattern_title: Advisory vs. Hands-On Execution Boundary Blur
summary: Deck stated consulting team would 'manage the system integrator delivery team and execute all ETL cutovers', contradicting the Control Tower advisory construct and creating commercial delivery liability.
resolution: Reframed consulting accountability to architecture stage-gate QA, golden blueprint certification, and AI migration accelerator enablement while assigning hands-on execution and SI management to customer and SI partner.

pattern_title: Missing Customer Dependencies and Objective Acceptance Criteria in Preview SOW
summary: Agentic AI Preview SOW lacked explicit customer data-access lead times, non-production environment prerequisites, and measurable deliverable acceptance gates.
resolution: Inserted Customer Responsibilities matrix, 5-business-day sign-off SLA, and quantitative evaluation acceptance thresholds.

pattern_title: Wall-of-Text Table Cells and Non-Compliant Multi-Hue Cards
summary: Credit strategy slide used 4-color pastel rounded cards, emojis in status columns, and 38-word outcome cells that wrapped to 5 lines.
resolution: Converted to sharp 0px monochrome graphite layout with single blue focal numeral, removed emojis, and compressed every table cell to <=15 words with a bold outcome lead-in.
